title: SEED-L06 period-1 schedule interest (HALF_UP vs HALF_EVEN discriminator)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the discriminating cell of the loan capture: the period-1 single-period interest of SEED-L06. request.principal_minor=10005050 is the capture's "principal":100050.500000 in minor units; request.rate_per_annum_pct=12 is the capture's "annualInterestRate":12.000000; request.days_in_year=360 and request.days_in_month=30 are the MANIFEST's roundingSurface.discriminatingInput day conventions (the loan product's 360/30 interest-day basis that makes the raw interest 1000.505). expect.interest_minor=100051 is the capture's periods[1].interestOriginalDue=1000.510000 in minor units, the HALF_UP posting where HALF_EVEN would have posted 1000.50. Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: expect.interest_minor is transcribed from periods[1].interestOriginalDue of the committed capture loan-L06-schedule-raw.json; the request day conventions are the MANIFEST's discriminatingInput; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan.
